test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Puneet is sitting between Iqbal and Aman. Joya is sitting at the second place to the right of Iqbal. Pratiksha is sitting at the third place to the left of Aman. Anamika is sitting between Joya and Aman. Who is sitting between Puneet and Anamika?
solution:
Six friends sitting around a circular table facing the centre

1) Joya is sitting at the second place to the right of Iqbal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c277cc6443a00b2adaea74e550e6ff3798f73558d9551f892c63301a987f3855.png] 

2) Puneet is sitting between Iqbal and Aman.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f06cd406812eaaab778e2295291b26cc5ac6178348d992ed204768ed7ed453a2.png] 

3) Pratiksha is sitting at the third place to the left of Aman.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37874ec9c136273b616c72ab0b594c74fee288310561ef4ef0930b2a7437fe83.png] 

4) Anamika is sitting between Joya and Aman.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2e1dd4af3eb4edef36400b747107aa387b085a8364f9fbbf9d7e8af71fd4286.png] 

Hence, “Aman” is sitting between Puneet and Anamika.
